title: NANPA authority for shard-A NPAs 816, 828, 831 and 837

data.notes: Current NANPA materials identify 816 (Missouri), 828 (North Carolina), 831 (California), and 837 (California overlay of 530) as in-service U.S. geographic NPAs. Each satisfies integer(NPA) mod 3 == 0.

title: Kansas City Food Not Bombs current profile

data.notes: Current profile states the Kansas City, Missouri Food Not Bombs chapter has shared weekly meals, groceries, clothing and other goods for more than a decade and supports occupations, strikes, marches and demonstrations.

title: Kansas City Mutual Aid current first-party site

data.notes: Current first-party site describes a community organization founded in 2020 that operates a community garden, fridge and pantry, Free Skool workshops, and Mutual Aid Day, with a stated aim of supporting individual and collective autonomy.

December 2025 reporting identifies Firestorm Books as an active Asheville bookstore cooperative and community hub that served as a donation and emergency-supply depot after Hurricane Helene; 2026 public event listings remain active.

title: Asheville Survival Program current public profile

data.notes: Current profile describes Asheville Survival Program as a decentralized grassroots network practicing mutual aid outside state institutions, with Streetside distributing food and supplies to the Asheville community and unhoused neighbors.

title: High Country Mutual Aid current first-party site

data.notes: Current first-party site describes a grassroots mutual-aid movement based in the Blue Ridge Mountains around Boone, North Carolina, providing community support, workshops, potlucks, skill-sharing and organizing meetings.

Current 2026 first-party posts describe SubRosa as a collectively run anarchist community space in downtown Santa Cruz offering radical literature, an Anarchist Lending Library, events, workshops and organizing space.

title: Santa Cruz Food Not Bombs current first-party site

data.notes: Current first-party site lists weekend meal and survival-gear sharing and documents Soupstock 2026; City of Santa Cruz also listed Food Not Bombs as organizer of the May 17, 2026 event.

title: 530 Food Rescue Coalition current public profile

data.notes: Current public hub links the 530 Food Rescue Coalition website, app, Instagram, Facebook and X. Current 2026 updates describe ongoing volunteer food recovery and redistribution across Butte County, based in Chico.
